The one positive signal is that last-15-minute buy SOL (9.99) outran sell SOL (8.32), with 43 buyers against 29 sellers, and the drawdown from the 30-minute high is only 0.07%. The coin is alive, the pool is deep at 1,078 SOL, and the 30-minute return is +3.8%.

But the rest points the other way. The coin is classed OPERATOR, and the first two minutes after graduation show 982 SOL bought from just 9 outside buyers, with the top 5 buyers taking 99.99% and a bundle share of 1.0. That is concentrated, bot-driven buying, not broad demand. The recent 43 buyers in 15 minutes are a small base, and sellers are active. Operator-backed coins have roughly broken even as a group, and this one's launch structure makes the late buying look more like exit liquidity than new conviction.

My view: there is no strong case to buy. The only support is a short window of net buying on a thin, concentrated holder base. I would skip this coin.
